steps.en: Clone the repo and install dependencies
Export an LLM key and a Jina key
steps.zh: 导出一个 LLM key 和一个 Jina key

steps.en: Ask a question from the command line
steps.zh: 在命令行里提一个问题

steps.en: Each step, the LLM picks one action: search, visit, reflect or answer
steps.zh: 每一步由 LLM 选一个动作：搜索、访问、反思或作答

steps.en: Reads pages through Jina Reader and stores findings and sub-questions
steps.zh: 经 Jina Reader 读网页，记下发现和子问题

steps.en: Grades each candidate answer for definitiveness and references; loops on failure
steps.zh: 检查候选答案是否确定、有无出处，不合格就继续循环

steps.en: Returns the answer with footnote citations, or forces one when the budget runs out
steps.zh: 返回带脚注引用的答案，预算耗尽时强行作答

value.en: A hard multi-hop question gets a short, referenced answer, with a token budget capping the cost
value.zh: 一个要跳好几步的难问题，换来一个简短、带出处的答案，花费由 token 预算封顶

sources: https://github.com/jina-ai/node-DeepResearch README "Install" (git clone, npm install) and "Usage" (export GEMINI_API_KEY, JINA_API_KEY; npm run dev $QUERY)
https://github.com/jina-ai/node-DeepResearch README "How Does it Work?" (actions search/visit/reflect/answer, evaluate answer: definitive + references, token budget, Beast Mode)
